classification_rule: Change only current operational consumers; preserve historical references, old exact-subject effect authorization carriers, replay projections, receipts, archive sources and scoped fixture/denial references. line_classifications.OPERATIVE_OR_CURRENT_DEFAULT_TEST: Current routing, default, bootstrap, status or interface binding, or a regression fixture following that current default; rebound only in this successor.
line_classifications.HISTORICAL_OR_FROZEN_SUBJECT: Historical identity, source URL, receipt, snapshot, exact-subject authorization carrier or its replay projection; preserve its original identity and scope.
line_classifications.SCOPED_FIXTURE_OR_GUARD: Synthetic/historical input or denial guard rather than a live default; preserve scoped validation.
